protocol.outer: Five official ESC-50 folds; original source IDs disjoint
protocol.inner: For each outer test fold, the next official fold cyclically is validation; only remaining three folds train inner models
protocol.selection: Per outer fold select config/epoch using its inner validation only; refit that config on four outer training folds; pool untouched outer predictions
protocol.ablation: Every fixed variant uses the same inner split/seed/optimizer and its own inner-selected epoch before outer refitting
protocol.final: Select configuration by mean inner-validation utility; median inner-selected epoch, refit all 390 ESC-50 recordings
protocol.utility: 0.8 * five-class macro recall + 0.2 * baby recall; external scores are never used for selection
protocol.normalization: Clean training folds only, separately recomputed for inner and outer fits
protocol.phone_augmentation: Random training-only view among clean, 16k->8k->16k, gain/clipping+8k, 8k+15..30dB Gaussian noise; feature gain +/-12dB, normalized noise .02 and feature/time masking
protocol.not_an_untouched_external_test: The user-confirmed 65 are an existing development-validation cohort; improvements there are developmental evidence

selection.config_selection_basis: Mean inner utility only; no external inference loaded
